outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: Chips & semiconductors, led by Micron, AMD, TSMC and Arm
strongest.reason: AI-chip demand signals stayed resilient across the board, with Micron up roughly 197% year-to-date and continued fund rotation into foundry and memory leaders even amid lingering semiconductor-tariff uncertainty

strongest.area: Enterprise software, led by Salesforce and ServiceNow
strongest.reason: both extended gains today, building on the AI-narrative reset from Salesforce's Agentforce momentum and the Anthropic-built Claudeforce plugin launch, which has drawn sympathy buying across the sector

weakest.reason: Cadence tumbled roughly 9% amid a broader selloff in richly-valued growth software tied to rising yields, plus renewed competitive unease after a Chinese AI model reportedly completed a chip-design flow using open-source tools

weakest.area: AI-disruption-exposed software and government-facing tech, led by Adobe and Palantir
weakest.reason: Adobe sank on a CEO-succession announcement just ahead of earnings, with analysts sharply divided over AI substitution risk to Creative Cloud, while Palantir stayed pressured by Google DeepMind's new government-facing cybersecurity AI model

outlook.nextStep: The August CPI report (Sept 11) and the Sept 15-16 FOMC decision are the key catalysts worth tracking closely, since rate-hike odds have been swinging on nearly every Fed comment. Adobe's Sept 10 earnings should help resolve the CEO-transition and AI-disruption debate, while Cadence's sharp drop is probably better watched for follow-through, given it's tangled up with sector-wide and competitive dynamics, than reacted to on a single day's move.

signals.title: Fed rate-hike odds stay elevated ahead of key CPI report
signals.body: Fed-funds futures price roughly two-thirds odds of a 25bp hike at the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting after Governor Waller's Sept 3 speech said inflation remains meaningfully above the 2% goal. The August CPI report due Sept 11 is now the single biggest near-term swing factor for the decision.
signals.focus: the most important date on the calendar this month worth tracking closely; day-to-day comment-driven swings are probably better watched than traded on

signals.title: Tesla stays soft after Cybercab disappointment and NHTSA probe
signals.body: Tesla shares remain pressured after last week's invite-only Cybercab event underwhelmed investors and the NHTSA opened an audit query into whether the vehicle's safety self-certification met federal standards, as the company began a small commercial robotaxi rollout in Austin.
signals.focus: a regulatory-risk headline worth watching for NHTSA's findings rather than reacting to short-term price moves

signals.title: Adobe slides on CEO transition days before earnings
signals.body: Adobe fell nearly 7% today as investors weighed the incoming CEO transition (Anil Chakravarthy succeeds Shantanu Narayen in December), just ahead of its Sept 10 earnings report. Analyst opinion is split, with Morgan Stanley flagging AI-substitution risk to Creative Cloud while other firms raised price targets.
signals.focus: a genuine fork in analyst opinion worth watching resolve at earnings rather than reacting to the transition headline alone

signals.title: Palantir stays pressured by Google DeepMind's cybersecurity AI model
signals.body: Google DeepMind's new purpose-built cybersecurity AI model, aimed at the same government and enterprise clients that anchor Palantir's business, continues to weigh on sentiment even as Palantir separately landed new government contract work.
signals.focus: a competitive-threat headline worth watching for follow-through rather than a reason to react to a single day's move

signals.title: Cadence tumbles on EDA sector selloff and AI competitive concerns
signals.body: Cadence Design Systems dropped roughly 9% as rising Treasury yields pressured richly-valued growth and design-software names, compounded by lingering unease after a Chinese AI model reportedly completed a full chip-design flow using only open-source EDA tools rather than licensed software from Cadence or Synopsys.
signals.focus: worth a closer look given the scale of the move, but probably better assessed over the next few sessions than reacted to immediately

signals.title: Enterprise software extends its rally on AI-narrative reset
signals.body: Salesforce and ServiceNow both advanced further today, building on late-August gains tied to Salesforce's Agentforce ARR growth and the Anthropic-built Claudeforce plugin launch, which has eased some investor fear about AI disrupting SaaS business models.
signals.focus: a sector-wide sentiment shift worth watching for durability rather than chasing after a multi-week run-up

signals.title: Crypto cools after a strong August as CPI report looms
signals.body: Bitcoin pulled back from its recent highs after a strong August in which spot ETFs pulled in $3.52 billion, the asset's best month of 2026. The SEC's newly proposed 'Regulation Crypto Assets' framework is open for public comment through Oct 20, adding a slow-moving regulatory backdrop.
signals.focus: a reminder of how sensitive crypto remains to both Fed expectations and evolving regulation; probably better watched through the Sept 11 CPI print than traded on daily swings
